propositions: A dedicated DC summary executor client must be constructed with max_retries=0 and reject nonzero session max_retries values.

Each DC summary write invocation must issue exactly GET/PUT/GET; a pre-mutation GET fault is retryable, a PUT fault is ambiguous (commit_unknown with no read-back), and a successful PUT requires read-back GET validation.
After an ambiguous PUT, a separate single-attempt GET observation determines recovery (desired state = recovered, old state = replay-eligible, failed GET = non-replaying commit_unknown).

Every DC terminal or exhausted outcome must emit exactly one completion log containing logical id, disposition, invocation/request counts, cleanup status, retry_not_before, and a redacted message capped at 512 code points, with total log size at most 1,024 code points.
The injected one-attempt/no-sleep policy for selected executor calls must preserve legacy wrapper defaults and client construction.
